title: Reaction Rates and Concentration
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Rate vs concentration data investigation using rate graphs, concentration tables, and collision models. No chemical reaction performance is required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for pH, rate factors, catalysts, equilibrium, and real-world claims
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation page opens, launch the reaction-rate activity on that exact page. Use the screen that lets you observe particle collisions or reaction progress. Change one factor at a time based on this lesson: concentration, temperature, catalyst, or activation-energy setting. Record the changed factor, what happened to collision frequency or successful collisions, the rate effect, and the evidence for Reaction Rates and Concentration.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
simulationSourceReference: PhET Reactions and Rates; CK-12; OpenStax Chemistry 2e
